rationale: wu_2015_trainable-claude-agentic: wu_n_bands=6, wu_n_outer=2, wu_motion_range=8, wu_motion_window=2, epochs=12, batch_size=1, lr=7e-05, weight_decay=0.0, loss_base=mse, lambda_neg=0.7, wu_soft_thresh=0.0008, wu_sigmoid_slope=6.0, wu_sigmoid_offset=1.0, wu_band_scale=1.0, wu_residual_blend=1.0, train_n=600, val_n=200, val_chunk=4, seed=42, rationale=ITER-17 (one knob vs iter-11 best). NUMBERS: soft_thresh=0.0008 optimum; motion_range=8 confirmed (12->0.2875 worse). Plateau 0.3088. Base = iter-11. FAILURE MODE: motion + residual knobs exhausted; sigmoid_slope INIT (band roll-off steepness around the Nyquist boundary f.dR==offset) untested this campaign. TPE kept 10.0. ONE KNOB: wu_sigmoid_slope 10.0 -> 6.0 (INIT only; still trainable, NO param change, 12 params). HYPOTHESIS: if the band roll-off starts shallower (slope=6) I expect val hr >= 0.3088 because a smoother sigmoid transition lets adjacent radial-frequency bands overlap and the learnable per-band scales get more graceful control over the aliasing-free FBP; risk = too-soft transition blurs the alias-suppression selection (hr down) -> slope=10 confirmed. Budget: ~735s.
